arxiv-1911-03342.title: Influence of Sensor Feedback Limitations on Power Oscillation Damping and Transient Stability
arxiv-1911-03342.creator: Joakim Björk, Danilo Obradović, Lennart Harnefors, and Karl Henrik Johansson
arxiv-1911-03342.description: Abstract Fundamental sensor feedback limitations for improving rotor angle stability using local frequency or phase angle measurement are derived. Using a two-machine power system model, it is shown that improved damping of inter-area oscillations must come at the cost of reduced transient stability margins, regardless of the control design method.

arxiv-2203-11874.title: Neural manifold analysis of brain circuit dynamics in health and disease
arxiv-2203-11874.creator: Rufus Mitchell-Heggs, Seigfred Prado, Giuseppe P. Gava, Mary Ann Go, Simon R. Schultz
arxiv-2203-11874.description: Abstract Recent developments in experimental neuroscience make it possible to simultaneously record the activity of thousands of neurons. However, the development of analysis approaches for such large-scale neural recordings have been slower than those applicable to single-cell experiments. One approach that has gained recent popularity is neural manifold learning.

arxiv-2209-03369.title: Dressed vs. Pairwise States, and the Geometric Phase of Monopoles and Charges
arxiv-2209-03369.creator: Csaba Csáki, Zi-Yu Dong, Ofri Telem, John Terning, and Shimon Yankielowicz
arxiv-2209-03369.description: Abstract We construct the Faddeev-Kulish dressed multiparticle states of electrically and magnetically charged particles, incorporating the effects of real and virtual soft photons. We calculate the properties of such dressed states under Lorentz transformations, and find that they can be identified with the pairwise multi-particle states that transform under the pairwise little group.

arxiv-2502-03242.title: Constructions and decoding procedures for quantum CSS codes
arxiv-2502-03242.creator: Yannick Saouter, Massinissa Zenia, Gilles Burel
arxiv-2502-03242.description: Abstract This article presents new constructions of quantum error correcting Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS for short) codes. These codes are mainly obtained by Sloane’s classical combinations of linear codes applied here to the case of self-orthogonal linear codes. A new algebraic decoding technique is also introduced. This technique is exemplified on CSS codes obtained from BCH, Reed-Muller and projective geometry codes.

pmc-11623895.title: Eyebrow bleeding as a rare migraine symptom: a case report
pmc-11623895.creator: Azita Tavasoli, Mohammad Rezazadeh, Maryam Kachuei
pmc-11623895.description: This case report documents a rare presentation of eyebrow bleeding occurring during migraine episodes in a 10-year-old girl, highlighting atypical signs associated with the disorder. Despite her normal neurological examinations and imaging studies, the patient experienced recurrent, severe headaches accompanied by localized bleeding and red spots on the forehead.

pmc-11678099.description: This study investigates radiomic efficacy in post-surgical traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI), overcoming MRI limitations from metal artifacts to enhance diagnosis, severity assessment, and lesion characterization or prognosis and therapy guidance. pmc-12450834.title: Different Contribution of Missense and Loss‐of‐Function Variants to the Genetic Structure of Familial and Sporadic Meniere Disease
pmc-12450834.creator: Alberto M. Parra‐Perez, Alvaro Gallego‐Martinez, Alba Escalera‐Balsera, Paula Robles‐Bolivar, Patricia Perez‐Carpena, Jose A. Lopez‐Escamez
pmc-12450834.description: Meniere disease (MD) is a chronic inner ear disorder with significant heritability. This study compares the burden of rare high‐ and moderate‐impact coding variants in an MD cohort to determine whether genetic burden in sporadic MD (SMD) overlaps familial MD (FMD), potentially revealing hidden inheritance in SMD.

pmc-12586795.title: Prognostic Impact of Time to Castration Resistance on Overall Survival in Patients With Metastatic Castration‐Sensitive Prostate Cancer
pmc-12586795.creator: Hiroaki Iwamoto, Tomohiro Hori, Takahiro Inaba, Ryunosuke Nakagawa, Taiki Kamijima, Hiroshi Kano, Tomoyuki Makino, Renato Naito, Hiroshi Yaegashi, Takahiro Nohara, Kazuyoshi Shigehara, Kouji Izumi, Atsushi Mizokami
pmc-12586795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesTreatment strategies for metastatic castration‐sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC) have advanced significantly, yet the prognostic impact of time to castration resistance (TTCR) on overall survival (OS) remains unclear. This retrospective study aimed to evaluate the relationship between TTCR and OS.MethodsAmong 218 patients diagnosed with pure prostatic adenocarcinoma and treated with combined androgen blockade therapy at Kanazawa University Hospital between 2000 and 2020, 160 who progressed to metastatic castration‐resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) were included.

pmc-13439979.title: Diagnosing Congenital Diaphragmatic Eventration Presenting With Transient Cardiac Dextroposition in an Adult: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13439979.creator: Yeganeh Rafiei, Behnaz Movahedi, Fatemeh Bayat, Fatemeh Zohrian
pmc-13439979.description: Congenital diaphragmatic eventration (CDE) is a rare developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal elevation of an intact hemidiaphragm due to deficient muscular development. Although often asymptomatic in adults, it may present with respiratory or gastrointestinal complaints. We report a 65‐year‐old man with congenital left hemidiaphragmatic eventration associated with gastric displacement and colonic interposition.

pmc-13508969.title: Patterns of Dorsal Fin Shape Variation in Commerson’s Dolphins Across Isolated Subantarctic Populations
pmc-13508969.creator: Franco Cruz-Jofré, María José Pérez-Álvarez, Analía San Martín, Frederick Toro, Juan Capella, Jorge Gibbons, Carlos Olavarría, Jorge Acevedo, Elie Poulin, Laura M. Pérez, Manuel J. Suazo, Alexis Matheu, Hugo A. Benítez
pmc-13508969.description: Simple SummaryCommerson’s dolphin occurs in geographically isolated populations across South America and the Kerguelen Islands in the southern Indian Ocean. We examined whether dorsal fin shape varies among these populations using geometric morphometric methods. Our results revealed differences in fin shape between subspecies and populations, although these patterns did not fully match previously described genetic structure.

pmc-13654802.title: Domain-specific perceptual grouping of human dyads: evidence from autistic trait profiles
pmc-13654802.creator: Bethany E. Richards, James T. Enns, Kim Shapiro, Liuba Papeo, Ana Pesquita
pmc-13654802.description: A longstanding debate in social cognition centres on distinguishing between cognitive processes that are specialised for social content and those that function across multiple domains. Recent research shows that the visual processing of human figures in apparent social interactions is marked by early perceptual grouping.
